description: Verify an HMAC (SHA-256/1/384/512) over a message with a caller-supplied secret. Returns valid bool. Secret is request-body only and never stored — for webhook authenticity checks. Free: 10 calls/day; then $0.001/call via x402 (MCP params._meta["x402/payment"] or HTTP) or X-API-Key credits.
name: hmac_verify
title: HMAC signature verifier
